what_happened: Found that a PostToolUse matcher=Bash hook family already exists (detect-noop-bash.sh, registered in merge-sources/settings-hooks.json's PostToolUse.Bash block), which is the exact missing piece needed to record a session's own git-stash-push results after the fact. This avoids inventing a new hook-registration mechanism and gives a precedent (CC_SESSION_ID validation, .claude/tmp/<purpose>-<session> state-file convention, env-var override for test isolation) to follow directly.

Research report recommended feeding the new stash pop/apply predicate into guard-destructive-git.sh's existing downstream MATCHED flow, but that flow sits AFTER the clean-tree early exit at line 299 -- a foreign pop on a clean tree (the most dangerous case, since nothing conflicts and the drop lands) would never have been checked. Plan corrects placement to a tree-state-blind hazard-class-3 predicate before line 299, modelled on the existing history-rewrite predicate, with its own inline grant check and exit 2 and no snapshot-marker exemption.

test-guard-git-push.sh's 'invalidation: expired grant (700s old) blocked' case fails (expects exit 2, got 0) both before and after this task's Phase 2 edits -- confirmed pre-existing via a detached worktree at this task's Phase 1 commit (0b6b43174), with no changes to push-grant-lib.sh's PG_EXPIRY_WINDOW/pg_grant_fresh logic in Phase 2. Unrelated to this task's file_scope; not chased further.

verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 against the repo root fails with 2 findings unrelated to this task: 'lean' extension doc-lint FAIL and a project-wide Rule S FAIL (context/project/lean4/patterns/measurement-harness-strictness.md missing from .claude/context/index.json). The 'core' extension (this task's own scope) PASSES doc-lint cleanly. Per dispatch guidance, this is the already-flagged lean doc-lint fixture registration gap excluded by sibling tasks in this batch; not chased further here.

The full, unfiltered verify-deploy.sh (gate 8 absent --skip-slow) calls tests/run-all.sh with no filter, which includes the literature extension's test-zotero-generate-export.sh, previously flagged as hanging indefinitely and filed as its own task. The complete, unfiltered gate set is therefore unreachable from this dispatch; narrow run-all.sh --only selections covering every collaborator suite this task touches were run instead (all passing). Not chased further, per dispatch guidance.

class: fast deploy-gate regression caught and fixed
what_happened: deploy-headless.sh's fast-gate run surfaced two real, task-caused defects before they could land silently: (1) gate 13 whole-tree orphan detection flagged the new tmp/stash-pre-*/tmp/stash-owned-* runtime-artifact files as undeclared orphans -- fixed by adding the exemption pattern to lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/verify.lua's is_runtime_artifact(), mirroring the existing tmp/noop-bash-count-*/tmp/noop-bash-shapes-* precedent, plus a new Assertion H in test-deploy-orphans.sh. (2) test-guard-destructive-git.sh's new acceptance fixtures never overrode STASH_PROVENANCE_STATE_DIR, so every suite run polluted the source store's own un-gitignored tmp/ directory with real per-session state files -- fixed by exporting an isolated scratch STASH_PROVENANCE_STATE_DIR for that whole section, matching test-record-stash-provenance.sh's existing convention. Both gates now pass cleanly.
